description: This file defines the FormBuilderInterface interface for Drupal's form API, including constants and method signatures related to form building, processing, and management.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Determines the ID of a form based on the provided form argument and form state.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Returns a renderable form array for the given form argument, used mainly as a menu callback.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds and processes a form for a given form ID, possibly performing redirects.

methods.name: rebuildForm
methods.description: Constructs a new form from form state, supporting multi-step workflows.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Retrieves, populates, and processes a form, simulating a form submission.

methods.name: retrieveForm
methods.description: Retrieves the form array or response object for a given form ID.

methods.name: processForm
methods.description: Processes a form submission, including validation and possible redirection.

methods.name: prepareForm
methods.description: Prepares a structured form array, adding elements and executing hook_form_alter.

methods.name: doBuildForm
methods.description: Builds the complete form array, executing #process and #after_build callbacks.
